settings.appearance.desc: Theme, text size, and the language of this window.
settings.archivist_model.tip: The menu lists models from the API host. Default uses RUNEBOOK_MODEL, then openai:gpt-6-luna.
settings.autosave.desc: Manual writes the note when you leave it or close the window.
settings.autosave.tip: The wait starts again after each change.
settings.capture.desc: Microphone, transcription, and how a new clip starts.
settings.microphone.tip: The transcript is saved. The audio file is not.
settings.models.desc: Keys and model names. An empty field uses the environment, then the default.
settings.models.load_failed: Could not load the model list.
settings.note_view.desc: Preview or source when a note opens.
settings.note_view.tip: The window stays on that view until you switch.
settings.notes.desc: How a note opens, and when a change is written.
settings.openai_key.desc: Key for Research and the Archivist.
settings.openai_key.tip: Empty checks OPENAI_API_KEY, then OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_GATEWAY_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, RUNINFRA_GATEWAY_KEY, and VERCEL_GATEWAY_KEY.
settings.reopen.desc: The next launch opens that note.
settings.reopen.tip: The note must still be in the vault. Otherwise the window opens welcome, then the first note.
settings.research.desc: Plans and writes a research note.
settings.research_model.desc: Model that writes the research note.
settings.research_model.tip: The menu lists models from the API host. Default uses OPENAI_MODEL, then gpt-5.6-luna.
settings.speech_language.tip: A two-letter code, such as en. Empty or auto lets Groq detect the language.
settings.speech_model.tip: Fast uses whisper-large-v3-turbo. Accurate uses whisper-large-v3.
settings.start_muted.tip: The mute button still changes the sound.
settings.text_size.desc: Size of text in the window.
settings.text_size.tip: Medium uses the size from the theme.
settings.theme.desc: Colors and type for the window.
settings.theme.tip: User themes are JSON files in the Runebook themes folder.
settings.title: Settings
settings.tool_rounds.desc: How many tool calls Research and the Archivist may make.
settings.tool_rounds.tip: The default is 250. A value below 1 is rejected.
settings.ui_language.desc: Language of menus and this page.
settings.ui_language.tip: English is available. A blank code uses English.
